description: Live spot prices of gold (XAU), silver (XAG), platinum (XPT) and palladium (XPD) per troy ounce, per gram and per kilogram, in any major currency. A metal whose feed is down is reported with its error instead of failing the whole call.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, for example USD, EUR, GBP, INR, AED, SAR, PKR, CAD, AUD. Default USD.

name: get_metal_prices
title: Get precious metal prices
